buildCommand: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); let html = fs.readFileSync('index.html', 'utf8'); html = html.replace(/%%FIREBASE_API_KEY%%/g, process.env.FIREBASE_API_KEY || ''); html = html.replace(/%%FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN%%/g, process.env.FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN || ''); html = html.replace(/%%FIREBASE_DATABASE_URL%%/g, process.env.FIREBASE_DATABASE_URL || ''); html = html.replace(/%%FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID%%/g, process.env.FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID || ''); fs.writeFileSync('index.html', html); console.log('✅ Firebase config injected');"
